goal: Compare Humble+Harmonic (unofficial pairing, this project's primary env) vs Jazzy+Harmonic (official pairing, Docker) using PHYS-001's physics-only vs ROS end-to-end methodology

environment.baseline: primary WSL2 environment (Ubuntu 22.04 + ROS2 Humble + Gazebo Sim 8.14.0), see PHYS-001
environment.network_mode: docker bridge (default) -- --network host was tried first and found to break DDS discovery entirely on this WSL2 Docker installation

bugs_found.description: docker run --network host makes ros2 topic list hang indefinitely (both rmw_fastrtps_cpp and rmw_cyclonedds_cpp), while gz-transport (non-ROS) partially works. Fixed by using Docker's default bridge network instead.

Same FastRTPS /dev/shm accumulation CTRL-005/INFRA-002 found in bare WSL2 (82 stale entries after repeated pkill -9 + relaunch cycles) reproduces inside a Docker container too -- confirms it's a general artifact, not WSL2-networking-specific. Cleared manually, one-off, same precedent as before.

ros_end_to_end_n3.ratio: ~6x larger variance in the officially-paired environment

notes: Honest negative result: the officially-paired Jazzy+Harmonic environment showed ~6x MORE ROS2/DDS-layer variance than the unofficial Humble+Harmonic environment, the opposite of NEXT_STEPS.md's hypothesized direction. Important confound stated plainly: Jazzy+Harmonic was tested inside a Docker container (an additional virtualization layer vs. Humble+Harmonic's bare-WSL2 testing), with direct evidence of real overhead (wall-clock time ~50-80% slower, one transient gz-transport service timeout that didn't occur in bare-WSL2 testing). This task does not disentangle 'official pairing' from 'containerization overhead' -- a controlled follow-up (Humble+Harmonic also tested inside an equivalent container) would be needed to isolate the true cause. What IS established cleanly: physics-solver determinism (0.0 rad diff, N=3) holds identically across both Gazebo Sim patch versions and both distro generations -- not environment-specific.
